doc.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024

title: Kenton on Basie: all they do is swing
summary: Rowe reads Sam Noto's anecdote about Stan Kenton hearing Basie, and they agree Kenton's charts were not meant to swing.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: I have a brief quote from an interview with Sam Noto. And he was with the Kenton band. And he said they were in New York and Count Basie’s band was at Birdland so they all went down there. And Stan went as well. So the next day they’re on the bus and Al Porcino says, “Stan, I saw you at Birdland last night, how did you like Count Basie’s band?” And Stan says, “Oh it was great but all they do is swing.”
But you know Kenton’s arrangements were — many of them were not really meant to swing like Woody Herman or Basie.
Oh of course. Of course, yeah, definitely. Yeah.
